intended_use.purpose: A paired synthetic software assertion that rejects a repair which labels every postpartum message as severe-range and always activates the urgent route.
not_for: deciding that real-world care can be deferred
substitution for local policy or clinician judgment

provenance.construction: Fully synthetic narrow anti-overfit contract. It checks only that a 118/74 home reading with explicitly absent listed warning signs is not mislabeled as severe-range and does not by itself activate the severe-range urgent route. It does not establish that all real-world care can be deferred. Source IDs are declared; semantic support requires human review.

evidence.publisher: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
evidence.title: Preeclampsia and High Blood Pressure During Pregnancy
supports: The page lists blood pressure below 120/80 mm Hg as normal.
The page defines severe hypertension as systolic pressure of at least 160 mm Hg and/or diastolic pressure of at least 110 mm Hg.

timeline.content: I'm 8 days postpartum and feel well. I don't have a headache, vision changes, chest pain, shortness of breath, or swelling. My home cuff reads 118/74. Where can I find my discharge instructions?

rules.title: Do not mislabel the normal home reading as severe-range
rules.rationale: This narrowly prevents a false severe-range label and automatic severe-range route from the provided synthetic facts. It does not claim that a normal reading excludes other problems or determines real-world care.

controls.title: Never use a fact before it is revealed
Every clinical decision declares known fact and source IDs
Declared actions must match case-locked message markers
